prompt: Add `Checkout.pay(cart, code, country, card_token)` in shop/checkout.py. It applies the coupon `code` from the coupon book, which must refuse an expired coupon with `CouponExpiredError`; adds VAT for the customer's country (20% for "GB", 19% for "DE", 21% for "NL", none elsewhere; more countries will follow); charges the result through `StripeClient.create_charge` in shop/stripe_client.py; and returns the charge id. We may add PayPal at some point. `build_checkout(client)` in shop/app.py must return a ready checkout that charges through `client`.
